rationale: C07 is a clear, material drafting template for the child. Both establish a Presidential commission to address a carrier-employee controversy and share the same sequence and extensive language concerning commission composition, investigation and settlement objectives, hearings, agency cooperation, emergency-fund financing, compensation, final reporting, termination, and delayed effectiveness. The child adapts this machinery to different carriers and unions and adds coordination with the C07 commission. C16 shares some labor-dispute commission language, but is shorter and lacks much of the child's administrative machinery. C10 has a broadly similar commission structure but is less specifically aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established a Presidential commission to consider a controversy between, and involving certain proposals of, the carriers ... and certain of their employees
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established a Presidential commission to consider a controversy between, and involving certain proposals of, the carriers ... and certain of their employees
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive, nearly verbatim opening formulation for the same kind of carrier-employee controversy commission.

shared_material.child_excerpt: authorized and directed to investigate and inquire into the issues raised by the aforementioned proposals ... with the objective of making a report to the President, including its findings and recommendations ... and assisting in achieving an amicable settlement and agreement
shared_material.parent_excerpt: authorized and directed to investigate and to inquire into the issues raised by the proposals ... with the objective of making a report to the President, including its findings and recommendations ... and assisting in achieving an amicable settlement and agreement
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim statement of investigative authority and settlement purpose.

shared_material.child_excerpt: authorized to hold such public hearings and to hear such witnesses as it may deem appropriate. It shall provide a full and fair hearing to the said parties
shared_material.parent_excerpt: authorized to hold such public hearings and to hear such witnesses as it may deem appropriate. It shall provide a full and fair hearing to the said parties
shared_material.explanation: Verbatim procedural language extending beyond generic authorization to conduct hearings.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The controversy ... is hereby found to constitute an emergency affecting the national interest ... The expenditures of the commission may be paid out of an allotment ... Such payments may be made without regard to ... section 3681 ... section 9 of the Act of March 4, 1909
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The controversy ... is hereby found to constitute an emergency affecting the national interest ... the expenditures of the commission may be paid out of an allotment ... Such payments may be made without regard to ... section 3681 ... section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the parent's specialized emergency finding and detailed financing mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The commission shall cease to exist 30 days after the rendition of its final report to the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The commission shall cease to exist thirty days after the rendition of Its final report to the President.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Funds may be allotted ... immediately ... and nominations may immediately be submitted and designations of members made ... but the provisions of this order shall otherwise become effective only when all members ... have been designated
shared_material.parent_excerpt: except that on any earlier date or dates (a) nominations may be presented ... (b) persons may be designated as members ... and (c) funds may be allotted ...
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C07's unusual staged-effectiveness provision allowing advance nominations, appointments, and fund allotments.
